name: Mount Snow

source.note: Piste reference data (not web-verified in this build) — confirm at source. Approximate Main Base position west of VT-100 in West Dover

Piste reference data (not web-verified in this build) — confirm at source. Commonly advertised figures (base ~1,900 ft, summit ~3,600 ft, vertical ~1,700 ft) The 3,600 ft summit matches Wikipedia (search summary, 2026-09-30).

Search summary (2026-09-30): 601 acres, 86 trails, 19 lifts including six high-speed detachable chairlifts, two of which run from the base to the 3,600 ft summit (other lift types not captured). Carinthia Parks (Vail 2025-26 Vermont tip sheet): an all-park face with 80–100 features in eight zones and 100+ acres of freestyle terrain — terrainParks left null because "zones" are not a park count.
Piste reference data (not web-verified in this build) — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'

character: A southern Vermont resort in the Deerfield Valley, operated by Vail Resorts, and one of the closest large Vermont ski areas to the New York and Boston metro areas. Its separate Carinthia base focuses on terrain parks.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at the Main Base. Learning-area details were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: No confirmed 2026-27 opening date on file as of 2026-09-30. OnTheSnow projects Nov 21, 2026 (a third-party projection, not an announcement). Vail Resorts released its 2026/27 opening dates on Aug 18, 2026, but the search summary did not show Mount Snow's date — check the release (More links). For reference, Okemo, Stowe and Mount Snow targeted Sat Nov 22, 2025 for 2025-26 (announced Oct 29, 2025) — a target, not a confirmed opening day.
